Vite module graph, production chunking and minification

HttpOnly session rotation, CSRF and exact Origin policy
tenant teardown, deny-default permission UX and anti-enumeration
runtime Zod contracts, response bounds and typed error semantics
ambiguity, reconciliation, verification and rollback semantics
XSS, URL, download, CSV, clipboard, redaction and telemetry policy
CSP, security headers, accessibility semantics and audit policy

escape: BFF contracts are plain JSON/Pydantic/Zod and framework-neutral
all enterprise authority remains in backend ports and ledgers
polling adapter accepts an injected fetch function
screens use semantic HTML/CSS without a design-system dependency

equivalent_operator_benchmark.journey: synthetic checkout health -> cited investigation -> denied exact-scope approval -> explicit ambiguous effect -> tenant teardown -> runtime health
equivalent_operator_benchmark.framework_result: 3 deterministic Chromium journeys passed in 9.3 seconds locally including server startup; axe reported zero violations on the canonical page
equivalent_operator_benchmark.custom_result: the pinned branch builds to 291588 JavaScript bytes and documents the equivalent deterministic checkout journey; its browser suite was not rerun in this repository
equivalent_operator_benchmark.candid_assessment: Framework Layer 12 is materially smaller in authored UI/BFF LOC but adds three TanStack runtime dependencies and a 50 percent larger uncompressed JavaScript bundle. The custom implementation has fewer runtime dependencies and more purpose-built polling/session/view code. Neither live-qualifies an IdP, browser fleet, assistive technology, or production deployment.
